verdict.rationale: Bevy has no traditional GUI editor (it's a code-first Rust engine), but a first-party Bevy Remote Protocol (BRP) exists that lets external programs inspect/mutate a running app's ECS world — the closest analog to scriptable scene/node/property control — though this is documented only via nascent community tooling (bevy_brp, 70 stars) rather than an official, richly documented agent-facing interface, and there's no official MCP server or documented 'trigger builds' capability. Missing for 10: an official documented agent-scripting interface/MCP server, first-party docs for programmatic scene/property editing, and build-triggering automation.
